profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company, traded as IBM, founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY. Its most recent 10-K, for the period ending 2025-12-31, reported revenue of $67,535,000,000. The material on its site covers IBM OpenPages, which IBM describes as a scalable, AI-powered and unified governance, risk and compliance platform, available on any cloud or on-premises, built from modules that customers can deploy individually.

IBM's tracked AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, described as a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules for risk assessment, regulatory mapping and automated documentation; IBM watsonx.governance, covering AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring and documentation, with EU AI Act accelerators, and named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026; and IBM watsonx, described as a model-agnostic enterprise AI platform with agent inventory, behavior monitoring and hallucination detection. The site also describes an OpenPages MCP Server that lets AI agents create, query and update GRC objects, and says IBM was recognized as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment. IBM states that Citi partnered with it to automate Citi's internal audit process using AI and machine learning.

IBM's litigation record shows 368 cases in New York.
